title: anvil-ring registration manifest (historical design artifact)
description: A proposed operator-facing registration record. The shipped Rust runtime does not consume this JSON; its binary WebSocket protocol is defined by cargo/src/frames.rs and docs/architecture.md.
$comment: Retained for design history and possible future control-plane work. It is deliberately not packaged by anvil-ring-tools and must not be described as the live wire contract.

protocol.description: Explicit version on the wire so an old client fails closed rather than mis-framing.

tether.description: Hub-side stable name. NOT derived from the remote hostname (rentals have arbitrary, sometimes user-supplied hostnames).

upstream.description: Local-only loopback upstream. Constrained by schema so a tether cannot be asked to proxy a non-local host (I-5: remote side does not describe its own permissions).

lease_expires_at.description: Bounded lifetime, per I-3. A revoked tether must die within one interval, so a lease may not be indefinite.

agent.description: Client version string, for fleet inventory only. Never used for authZ.
